articles.summary: Xi to attend SCO Summit and visit Egypt - Xi will travel to Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan to attend the SCO summit and pay a state visit there. He will then go on to Egypt for a state visit. He leaves August 30 and returns September 3. Xi’s most-watched meetings at the event may be with India’s Modi and Russia’s Putin. We still do not know why the director of the CIA flew to Russia yesterday for two hours, but it may have been to warn Putin about escalating in Ukraine and perhaps against NATO.
